name: Tiangong 2
about: Tiangong 2 (2016-057A), a station core, launched 2016 Sep 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (D).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2016 Sep 18), held fixed
